description: Several years ago I found that there was not a good Power BI Map Visualization (using Open Source Mapping tools) to show routes between points for use in logistics projects. This is a rewrite of that visualization using React rather than D3, as well as incorporating many of the new features and requirements of the latest version of React (19.1) and Power BI Visuals API / Framework (API 5.11.1). Due to some changes with openstreetmap.org the tile set needed to be used from stadiamaps.com. You need to go to https://stadiamaps.com and get a free key. In your map under the settings for the Visual under "General Map Settings" you will see a place for API Key. Put the Stadia key there. The next version will allow you to use other Tile Providers.. Please try it out and request any updates / features you would find useful.
